evidence: Across the reporting prior to May 15, 2022, Bitcoin has experienced severe volatility triggered by the Terra/UST ecosystem collapse, bouncing from lows near $26,000 back toward the $29,000-$30,000 range. While institutional and whale dip-buying is evident (notably substantial inflows into Canada's Purpose Bitcoin ETF and whale accumulation), the market faces significant overhead resistance around $30,000. Furthermore, reports regarding the Luna Foundation Guard moving tens of thousands of BTC to exchanges create an ongoing supply overhang and cautious sentiment among market analysts, who warn against expecting a sharp V-shaped recovery over the immediate 24-hour horizon.
limitations: All supplied articles originate from unverified free crypto news outlets rather than authenticated Tier-1 financial media or Yahoo reporting.
Rapidly developing on-chain liquidations related to the Terra/LUNA crisis introduce significant tail-risk and volatility not fully captured in standard news reporting.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
